No figure was synthesized by differencing covers - the This-Report cell is printed here. 2024 3-line variant, no separate <=$50 aggregate line. No in-kind rows, so both in-kind conventions agree.

itemized.escalation_note: Five 600 dpi tight --value crops. Two were EXPLORATORY, needed because neither schedule page yielded any v_rules: a wide amount-column strip on each page (pct:14.0,6.18,20.0,10.27@p51 and pct:14.0,5.45,20.0,9.96@p52) rendered the printed row rules together with the amounts, letting the row boundaries be measured against a known window instead of estimated. Three were A3 proofs: p51 row 1 rendered 75.00; p52 row 1 rendered 31.98 and row 3 rendered 16.98. No legibility escalation was needed. NOTE: 900 dpi was not used on this 2024 combined archive - see the sibling record 7bbe69af, where 900 dpi returns blank crops on this file's oversized pages; 600 dpi renders cleanly here (these three pages are ordinary 612x792 pt letter pages, unlike pp.161-164).

itemized.notes: Typed 2024 3-line filing, October-8 pre-election box checked, signed 10/4/2024; p50 cover (portrait), p51 Form A and p52 Form B, both bound as ROTATED LANDSCAPE sheets that poppler renders portrait - page ORDER is the form order here, but page ORIENTATION is not, and the frames declare axis='x' accordingly. The county blacked out the candidate's whole address block on the cover; on Form A the filer simply left the city and state empty behind a street line - a county REDACTION and a filer OMISSION on the same filing, recorded as the two different facts they are. This is the smallest 2024 county-office campaign in the chunk (1,575.00 raised cumulative). The cover's December-5 checkbox carries the county's own stale year ('through December 31, 2022' on a 2024 form) - a form-template defect, noted, not corrected.
